market: Europe Hot Melt Glue Sticks Market
market_definition: The hot melt glue sticks market comprises cylindrical solid adhesive sticks designed for use in hand-held and industrial glue guns. It measures sales of finished sticks of any polymer base sold to consumers, crafters and trades. BY STICK DIAMETER: 7 mm (Mini), 11 mm (Standard), Other Diameters. BY POLYMER BASE: EVA, Polyolefin, Other Polymer Bases. BY PERFORMANCE GRADE: General Purpose, High-Temperature, Low-Temperature, Specialty (Coloured, Glitter, Flame-Retardant). BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Arts, Crafts & Household, Packaging, Woodworking & Furniture, Electronics & Repairs, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Bulk hot melt granules, blocks and slugs; glue guns and application equipment; reactive PUR hot melt cartridges. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
